confidence_notes: Beer and coffee are the best-corroborated anchors; several sources agree within roughly 10-15%. The inexpensive meal anchor blends Numbeo's about CHF 30 average (meal only) with about CHF 22-28 basic-meal-with-drink figures. The mid-range two-person meal follows Numbeo's about CHF 150 average. One other source puts it near CHF 50 for two, which looks too low for three courses, so the spread is wide. Cocktail rests on one crowd-sourced listing (about CHF 14) that its site flags as unreliable; I set it at CHF 15. No per-glass wine price for Lugano was found, so wine is set at about 1.2 times the beer anchor. The Numbeo bottle figure of about CHF 10.25 was not used because it is a bottle price. CHF figures were converted to USD at about 1.12 USD per CHF, a rate implied by dual-currency listings in the sources (about 1.10-1.13), not a dedicated CHF rate pull. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July high season, not based on searched listings or booking pages. FX: the RBA AUD/USD midpoint for 18 Nov 2026 was taken from the RBA exchange-rate pages, not the F11 file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Lugano-specific aggregated figures, with Locarno (Ticino) listings as a secondary check. Accommodation is benchmarked holistically against mid-sized Swiss lakeside tourist towns in summer peak season, from model knowledge only.
